LEARN MORE

Frequently asked questions

Can't find the right answer here? Visit our FAQ

If my results show something concerning, what happens next?

If any concerning findings are detected, one of Biograph’s doctors will reach out to you right away and provide a clear and detailed explanation of your results from your comprehensive health testing. Our team will guide you through the next steps, ensuring that you understand the severity of the findings and your options for further evaluation or treatment.

We also facilitate referrals to top specialists, both locally and internationally, and provide ongoing support to help you navigate the next phase of your health journey. Learn more about How Biograph Works.

How is Biograph different from a regular doctor or concierge medical practice?

Biograph doesn’t replace your primary care physician (PCP). Instead, it complements traditional healthcare by focusing on advanced diagnostics, prevention, and longevity health services through a full body health check. While your PCP and/or concierge doctor manages your general health, Biograph provides a comprehensive, data-driven evaluation that detects risks before symptoms appear.

If you need a PCP, we have an excellent referral network of PCPs who take a more preventive and longevity-focused approach. Once you are onboarded, we’d be happy to provide recommendations based on our existing relationships.

What makes the Biograph experience unique compared to similar companies?

Many companies either offer only one or two standalone tests or run a long list of diagnostics without a clear, actionable framework. Some services provide limited testing, such as a whole-body MRI or genetic screening, which, while useful, fail to give a comprehensive picture of health. Others offer an extensive range of diagnostics but lack a structured, system-based approach, leaving patients with fragmented data and no clear plan. The Biograph experience is different.

Our curated set of advanced assessments is designed to generate meaningful, personalized insights across five critical health pillars: cardiovascular disease, metabolic dysfunction, brain health, cancer risk, and quality of life. Every test is selected for its clinical relevance and actionability, ensuring that we’re not just collecting data but providing clear recommendations for optimizing long-term healthspan through structured longevity testing.

What if I want to book for more than one person at a time?

Many Biograph members choose to participate in our longevity program alongside a partner, family member, or friend. We also frequently host executive teams who schedule their comprehensive health checks on the same day. Depending on your preference, we can adjust the visit to accommodate more than one member, including sharing a private suite or reserving multiple suites for your group.

Our team will coordinate all bookings to ensure alignment on the same day, subject to availability. To book for more than one person, email info@biograph.com.

Is Biograph covered by insurance?

Biograph operates as a private healthcare service and does not accept insurance at this time.
